editorial:
Imagine waking up with no memory of who you are, only to find out you are a top-secret spy. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow a Pakistani agent who is totally convinced he is actually a brave Indian counter-terrorism officer. The whole vibe is a wild mix of silly misunderstandings and high-energy chases. It feels like a big, colorful ride where the main character is constantly confused, but he is still incredibly good at fighting. You will find yourself laughing at the awkward situations he gets into while he tries to do the right thing for a country that is not even his own.

The action scenes are punchy and the jokes land well, making the movie fly by quickly. While some of the plot holes are a bit big, the great acting keeps you invested in the journey. If you love movies that don't take themselves too seriously, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: In the final act, the main character finally recovers his memories during a huge showdown. He realizes he was sent to infiltrate the Indian agency but actually grew to love the people there. Instead of completing his mission for Pakistan, he chooses to stop a terrorist attack on both countries. He ends up becoming a double agent who works in the shadows to keep the peace between the two nations, finally finding his true purpose.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action comedies and spy stories with a twist.
